text:
When the Dharma is on the wane and the lower realms are increasing,
The wise will be deeply saddened
And will be frightened like deer.
King of Supreme Joy
If a bodhisattva practices the six perfections for a thousand eons,
apart from skillful means,
the merit of rejoicing in hearing this samādhi
does not come close to a hundredth of the merit of the previous merit,
and it does not come close to a fraction.
When this Dharma teaching was given,
Countless bodhisattvas gave rise to the mind set on unsurpassed and perfect awakening.
All of them became irreversible from unsurpassed and perfect awakening.
Eight hundred thousand beings of the gods and humans
became free from dust and defilements, and their Dharma eyes became perfectly pure with regard to phenomena.
Those gods, with their perfectly pure Dharma eyes,
were so delighted by the Blessed One’s Dharma that they scattered flowers all over the trichiliocosm.
The trichiliocosm
